title: OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器
summary: 以開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面解析OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore OCP Yosemite V3 modular server through open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 公開伺服器與超算架構的離線工作流、通信、儲存及能量模型；非機櫃接線、供電施工或實體維護SOP，也不表示學員取得廠商／研究中心設備存取。
scopeEn: Offline workflow, fabric, storage and energy models of public servers/HPC. No rack-wiring, power-installation or physical-maintenance SOP and no vendor/research-center hardware access is implied.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器案例中比較sled與主機拓撲與平臺接口與I/O，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate sled/host topology and platform interfaces and i/o within the OCP Yosemite V3 modular server case.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對sled與主機拓撲提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for sled/host topology.
steps.instruction: 在「OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識sled與主機拓撲。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify sled/host topology in the mentor diagram and primary sources for OCP Yosemite V3 modular server. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
steps.check: 提交sled與主機拓撲的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for sled/host topology.

knowledge.title: 節點與記憶體層級
knowledge.text: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 本課架構對應：sled與主機拓撲
knowledge.textEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Course architecture correspondence: Sled/host topology

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設固定工作量有串行比例 0.020，使用 8 個理想同速工作者，Amdahl 上限 S=1/[f+(1−f)/N]=7.0175。通信、負載不均及I/O尚未計入，實效不得用此上限當實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume serial fraction 0.020 and 8 ideal equal workers: Amdahl upper bound S=7.0175. Communication, imbalance and I/O are omitted; this bound is not measured performance.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器」的「節點與記憶體層級：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Nodes and memory hierarchy: architecture analysis” in “OCP Yosemite V3 modular server”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 就sled與主機拓撲的「節點與記憶體層級」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for nodes and memory hierarchy in sled/host topology?
options: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。
統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access.
Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
quiz.explanationEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對sled與主機拓撲提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for sled/host topology.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「節點與記憶體層級」模型，檢查sled與主機拓撲的兩個假想案例。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous nodes and memory hierarchy model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving sled/host topology. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
steps.check: 提交sled與主機拓撲的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for sled/host topology.

steps.title: 節點內與節點間網路：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Intranode and internode networks: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對平臺接口與I/O提出可反駁的節點內與節點間網路模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable intranode and internode networks model and evidence record for platform interfaces and i/o.
steps.instruction: 在「OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識平臺接口與I/O。高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。 建立節點內與節點間網路的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify platform interfaces and i/o in the mentor diagram and primary sources for OCP Yosemite V3 modular server. Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of intranode and internode networks, focusing on open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observationEn: Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：節點內GPU互連規格等於跨機櫃網絡規格。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Intranode GPU rates equal interrack fabric rates.
steps.check: 提交平臺接口與I/O的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for platform interfaces and i/o.

options: 節點內GPU互連規格等於跨機櫃網絡規格。
